# Reading List

> Copy of [Reading List](https://github.com/SOsintOps/intelligence-field-notes/blob/main/docs/reading-list.md) from [Intelligence Field Notes](https://github.com/SOsintOps/intelligence-field-notes) 0.1.1. The original is the reference; this copy is here for offline use.

The texts these notes draw on, with a link to each. Free official copies are preferred; where a book is sold, the link goes to the publisher or the author. Every link was checked on 13 October 2026. Some US government sites (dni.gov, dia.mil) refuse automated requests but open normally in a browser.

## Intelligence Analysis
- **"Psychology of Intelligence Analysis"** by Richards J. Heuer Jr. (CIA Center for the Study of Intelligence, 1999) - How analysts think, the cognitive biases that distort judgement, and Analysis of Competing Hypotheses. [CIA page](https://www.cia.gov/resources/csi/books-monographs/psychology-of-intelligence-analysis-2/) · [PDF](https://www.cia.gov/resources/csi/static/Pyschology-of-Intelligence-Analysis.pdf)
- **"Structured Analytic Techniques for Intelligence Analysis"** (3rd edition, CQ Press / SAGE) by Randolph H. Pherson and Richards J. Heuer Jr. - Sixty-six structured techniques, by family. [SAGE](https://www.sagepub.com/en-us/cab/structured-analytic-techniques-for-intelligence-analysis/book255432)
- **"A Tradecraft Primer: Structured Analytic Techniques for Improving Intelligence Analysis"** (CIA, 2009) - A free, short introduction to the main techniques. [CIA page](https://www.cia.gov/resources/csi/books-monographs/a-tradecraft-primer/) · [PDF](https://www.cia.gov/resources/csi/static/955180a45afe3f5013772c313b16face/Tradecraft-Primer-apr09.pdf)
- **"Words of Estimative Probability"** by Sherman Kent (*Studies in Intelligence*, vol. 8, no. 4, 1964) - Why estimative words need agreed odds. [CIA page](https://www.cia.gov/resources/csi/studies-in-intelligence/archives/vol-8-no-4/words-of-estimative-probability/)
- **"Criminal Intelligence: Manual for Analysts"** by Howard Atkin (UNODC, 2011) - The intelligence process for law enforcement: 4 x 4 evaluation, link, event, flow and telephone analysis, inference, presentation. [PDF](https://www.unodc.org/documents/organized-crime/Law-Enforcement/Criminal_Intelligence_for_Analysts.pdf) · [UN Library Vienna record](https://unov.tind.io/record/68083)
- **"Criminal Intelligence: Manual for Front-line Law Enforcement"** (UNODC, 2010) - The companion volume for officers who collect and report. [PDF](https://www.unodc.org/documents/organized-crime/Law-Enforcement/Criminal_Intelligence_for_Front_Line_Law_Enforcement.pdf)

## Standards and Directives
- **"ICD 203: Analytic Standards"** (ODNI, 2015, as amended) - The five analytic and nine tradecraft standards; the likelihood scale. [PDF](https://www.dni.gov/files/documents/ICD/ICD-203.pdf)
- **"ICD 206: Sourcing Requirements for Disseminated Analytic Products"** (ODNI) - Source descriptors, source summary statements, citations. [PDF](https://www.dni.gov/files/documents/ICD/ICD-206.pdf)
- **"ICD 208: Maximizing the Utility of Analytic Products"** (ODNI, 2017) - Writing for the widest useful readership. [PDF](https://www.dni.gov/files/documents/ICD/ICD-208-Maximizing-the-Utility-of-Analytic-Products-2017-01-09.pdf)
- **"Berkeley Protocol on Digital Open Source Investigations"** (OHCHR and UC Berkeley Human Rights Center) - International standard for collecting, preserving and verifying digital open-source information. [Human Rights Center](https://humanrights.berkeley.edu/publications/berkeley-protocol-on-digital-open-source-investigations/) · [UN Digital Library](https://digitallibrary.un.org/record/3973652)
- **"Traffic Light Protocol (TLP) 2.0"** (FIRST) - The handling markings for shared intelligence. [first.org](https://www.first.org/tlp/) · [CISA guidance](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/news/traffic-light-protocol-tlp-definitions-and-usage)

## OSINT Practice
- **"OSINT Techniques: Resources for Uncovering Online Information"** (11th edition, 2024) by Michael Bazzell and Jason Edison - The practical reference on search, tools and the investigator's VM. Earlier editions were titled *Open Source Intelligence Techniques*. [IntelTechniques](https://inteltechniques.com/book1.html)
- **"Extreme Privacy: What It Takes to Disappear"** (5th edition, 2024) by Michael Bazzell - Privacy and anonymity, the ground of investigator OPSEC. [IntelTechniques](https://inteltechniques.com/book7.html)
- **"Deep Dive: Exploring the Real-World Value of Open Source Intelligence"** (Wiley, 2023) by Rae L. Baker, foreword by Micah Hoffman - OSINT for new and intermediate analysts, with case studies. [Wiley](https://www.wiley.com/en-us/Deep+Dive%3A+Exploring+the+Real+world+Value+of+Open+Source+Intelligence-p-9781119933243)
- **"Verification Handbook"** (European Journalism Centre) - Verifying accounts, images, video and claims. [verificationhandbook.com](https://verificationhandbook.com/)
- **Bellingcat guides** - Open-source investigation how-tos. [bellingcat.com](https://www.bellingcat.com/category/resources/how-tos/)
- **Follow the Money** - The data model for people, companies, ownership and payments used by investigative tools. [followthemoney.tech](https://followthemoney.tech)

## Cyber Threat Intelligence
- **"Visual Threat Intelligence: An Illustrated Guide for Threat Researchers"** (2023) by Thomas Roccia - CTI fundamentals, the Diamond Model, ATT&CK, ACH and the analyst's tools, illustrated. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Visual-Threat-Intelligence-Illustrated-Researchers/dp/B0C7JCF8XD) · [author's site](https://www.securitybreak.io/)
- **"Il ransomware nell'economia del cybercrime: analisi d'intelligence sul gruppo Conti"** (Edizioni Themis, 2023) by Giuseppe Brando, Marco Di Costanzo and Camilla Salini - Italian; an intelligence analysis of the Conti group after the ContiLeaks. [Edizioni Themis](https://edizionithemis.it/catalogo/scienze-sociali-tecnologiche-e-della-sicurezza/il-ransomware-nell-economia-del-cybercrime)

## Intelligence Writing
This section absorbs the [awesome-intelligence-writing](https://github.com/mxm0z/awesome-intelligence-writing) list by Ygor Maximo (MIT licence), checked link by link in October 2026: dead links were replaced with a working copy where one exists, or dropped.

### Official manuals and guides
- **CIA, "Style Manual & Writers Guide for Intelligence Publications"** (8th edition, 2011). [PDF (FAS)](https://irp.fas.org/cia/product/style.pdf) · [PDF (The Black Vault)](https://documents.theblackvault.com/documents/cia/cia-styleguide.pdf)
- **CIA, "Analytic Thinking and Presentation for Intelligence Producers"** (analysis training handbook). [cryptome.org](https://cryptome.org/cia-ath-pt1.htm)
- **Mercyhurst College Institute for Intelligence Studies, "The Analyst's Style Manual"**. [PDF](https://ncirc.bja.ojp.gov/sites/ncirc/files/media/document/analysts_style_manual.pdf)
- **Defense Intelligence Agency, "Style Manual for Intelligence Production"** (2016). [PDF (governmentattic.org)](https://www.governmentattic.org/23docs/DIAstyleManualIntelProd_2016.pdf)
- **US Army Intelligence Center of Excellence, writing programme resources**. [USAICoE Writing Program](https://intellibrary.libguides.com/c.php?g=654854&p=6527880) · [Enhancing Your Intelligence Writing](https://intellibrary.libguides.com/ld.php?content_id=53826333)
- **"How to Write an Intelligence Product in the Bottom Line Up Front (BLUF) Format"** (US DOJ material). [PDF](https://courses.physics.illinois.edu/phys280/sp2022/docs-for-assignments/BLUF%20Writing%20Format.pdf)
